newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar ends softer at 473.25/474.25/dlr.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar ends softer at 473.25/474.25/dlr.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar slipped in nervous and volatile trade to close at 473.25/474.25 bolivars per dollar, traders said, after ending Thursday 473/474 per dollar Thursday.
"The market opened and the dollar quickly dropped to 470," said one broker. "But then it bounced back and the Central Bank came in, selling dollars," he added.
Traders said speculation was heavy and that most of the trade was on the interbank market, rather than on behalf of final clients.
